presentation.label: Ear pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about your ear pain.  You may want to tell us when it started, which side it is affecting, whether you have had other symptoms like a cold, and whether there is hearing loss or discharge

questions.question: Have you had a fever with this ear pain?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had a fever?

questions.question: Have you noticed any discharge coming from the ear?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate there is discharge coming from the ear?

questions.question: Have you experienced any hearing loss in the affected ear?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has experienced hearing loss?

questions.question: Have you had any associated cold symptoms such as sore throat, cough or runny nose?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response mention sore throat, cough or runny nose?
